description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Suzuki Samurai LWB Rear Seat
These are NOT COVERS but rather the COVERS/FRAMES & CUSHIONS
The seat color pattern is a light color that is designed to reflect the suns heat giving you a cooler seat in the summer, especially when the tops off.
These seats are made from heavy, durable pressed vinyl and have an off-white patterned seating area and a dark gray side and back.
They match the front seats I offer.
Note: These seats do not come with bracketry, but are the cushion and back. Back supports will also be necessary for structure. These brackets are not available and will need to be fabricated. Seat width is ~48″.
NOTE: This is NOT the rear seat for the Short Wheel Base. Please see all images if you want to modify current seat.
This item is NON-Returnable
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seat Bottom Cushion
Qty 1 – Seat Back Cushion
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models – Long Wheel Base
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models – Long Wheel Base
